mechanism: Paroxetine inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, increasing valbenazine and its active metabolite (NBI-98854) concentrations; additive CNS depression and QT prolongation risk from both agents.
action: Monitor for increased valbenazine adverse effects (akathisia, somnolence, orthostasis); consider dose reduction of valbenazine or alternative SSRI with less CYP3A4 inhibition; monitor ECG if QT risk factors present.
